description: Vectors of T5 (W2-1), run by both implementations: lib/lessons/diagrams/insolation.rb in test/lib/lessons/maps_types_test.rb and app/javascript/lesson/diagrams/maps/insolation.js in app/javascript/lesson/test/maps.test.mjs. Columns: schema (valid or invalid), semantic ('ok' or {code, path} of the first finding), layout ('ok' or 'error', at 320, 390, 768 and 1280 px and fontPx 18, 20 and 26), describe (per state, the Italian text of the visible state at the default controls), printed (per state, the strings of L4), targets and neutral (per set, in reading order), reachable, served_select (the neutral projection of a select figure). Invented content only.

data.alt_it: Il profilo della Terra con raggi paralleli su tre latitudini: la stessa luce si spalma su più terreno lontano dall'equatore.
